::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight 1 Corinthians addresses practical problems within a growing church while emphasizing unity, holiness, love, worship, and sound doctrine. The book teaches that the gospel of Christ should transform every area of life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
1 Corinthians 1:18
The preaching of the cross
### Why This Verse Core gospel message ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses divisions within the church and emphasizes Christ as the center of unity. The key verse highlights the power and wisdom of God revealed through the message of the cross. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
1 Corinthians 2:9
Eye hath not seen
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted promise ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts human wisdom with spiritual wisdom. The key verse teaches that spiritual truth is understood through the Holy Spirit. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
1 Corinthians 3:16
Ye are the temple of God
### Why This Verse Identity of believers ### Chapter Insight This chapter rebukes spiritual immaturity and factionalism. The key verse reminds believers that they are God's temple and that God dwells among them. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
1 Corinthians 4:2
It is required in stewards that a man be found faithful
### Why This Verse Stewardship principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter discusses faithful stewardship in ministry. The key verse emphasizes humility and accountability before God rather than seeking human approval. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
1 Corinthians 5:7
Christ our Passover is sacrificed for us
### Why This Verse Christological significance ### Chapter Insight This chapter confronts serious sin within the church. The key verse stresses the necessity of holiness and discipline within the Christian community. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
1 Corinthians 6:19
Your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost
### Why This Verse One of Paul's most quoted teachings ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses lawsuits among believers and sexual morality. The key verse teaches that believers should glorify God with their bodies because they belong to Him. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
1 Corinthians 7:17
As God hath distributed to every man
### Why This Verse Calling and contentment ### Chapter Insight This chapter provides instruction regarding marriage, singleness, and contentment. The key verse emphasizes faithfulness to God in whatever situation one finds oneself. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
1 Corinthians 8:9
Take heed lest your liberty become a stumbling block
### Why This Verse Christian liberty ### Chapter Insight This chapter discusses Christian liberty and responsibility. The key verse teaches that love should govern the exercise of personal freedoms. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
1 Corinthians 9:24
Run that ye may obtain
### Why This Verse Spiritual discipline ### Chapter Insight This chapter explains Paul's willingness to sacrifice personal rights for the sake of the gospel. The key verse emphasizes becoming all things to all people in order to lead some to Christ. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
1 Corinthians 10:13
God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able
### Why This Verse One of the most memorized verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns against spiritual complacency and idolatry. The key verse teaches believers to do everything for the glory of God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
1 Corinthians 11:1
Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ
### Why This Verse Discipleship ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses worship practices and the Lord's Supper. The key verse emphasizes remembering Christ's sacrifice through communion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
1 Corinthians 12:27
Ye are the body of Christ
### Why This Verse Spiritual gifts and unity ### Chapter Insight This chapter teaches about spiritual gifts and the unity of the body of Christ. The key verse highlights that all believers are essential members of one body. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
1 Corinthians 13:13
Faith, hope, charity; but the greatest of these is charity
### Why This Verse Famous "love chapter" conclusion ### Chapter Insight This chapter celebrates the supremacy of love. The key verse teaches that love is the greatest Christian virtue and the foundation for all ministry. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
1 Corinthians 14:40
Let all things be done decently and in order
### Why This Verse Church order ### Chapter Insight This chapter provides instruction regarding orderly worship and spiritual gifts. The key verse emphasizes edification and clarity within the church. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
1 Corinthians 15:58
Be ye steadfast, unmovable
### Why This Verse Resurrection chapter climax ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents the resurrection of Christ and believers. The key verse declares Christ's resurrection as the foundation of Christian faith and hope. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
1 Corinthians 16:14
Let all your things be done with charity
### Why This Verse Final exhortation ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains final instructions, greetings, and encouragement. The key verse calls believers to remain steadfast, courageous, and strong in the Lord. :::
